title: Initiative ripple model and execution-slice playbook for company OKR alignment
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background:
Over the last two quarters we've seen slippage on company-level OKRs caused by misaligned initiative boundaries, unclear handoffs between Platform, Product, and Design, and opaque capacity assumptions (reserved vs burst). This ticket creates an actionable playbook to thread company OKRs into cross-functional initiatives using an 'initiative ripple model' and timeboxed 'execution slices' so teams can plan, triage, and sequence work with predictable capacity and clear gating criteria.

Goals and scope:
- Define the initiative ripple model: how changes in one initiative (scope, schedule) propagate to dependent initiatives and OKRs.
- Create an execution-slice template: a minimal, timebound unit (2–6 weeks) with clear deliverables, owners, metrics, and roll-forward rules.
- Establish initiative contract and gating checklist for cross-team handoffs.
- Produce a dependency registry format and dashboard spec for Console to visualize ripple impact (per-initiative, per-OKR).
- Ship a lightweight cadence (weekly triage + monthly sync) and escalation runbook.

Deliverables:
1) Initiative Ripple Model doc (Confluence): diagrams, sample ripple maps, and propagation rules. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OKR/Initiative+Ripple+Model
2) Execution-Slice template + PRD: template for scope, acceptance, metrics, capacity slice, rollback plan. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/exec-slices
3) Initiative contract template (owner, SLIs, deps, unblockers) and a sample filled contract for runtime-1.18 upgrade.
4) Dashboard spec for Console (wireframes + data fields) to show ripple heat, committed capacity, and slack.
5) Playbook checklist and runbook for triage/escalation.

Acceptance criteria:
- PMs and Eng leads can map every company-level OKR to at most 3 live initiatives per quarter with defined execution slices.
- Initiative contract templates used for all cross-team initiatives in Cycle 2026-Q2 pilot.
- Console dashboard prototype shows dependency graph and a "ripple severity" score for >= 10 sample initiatives.

Gating checklist (for an initiative to be considered "Execution Ready"):
- Contract signed by PM and Eng lead (or declared exceptions).
- Capacity slice assigned (GPU hours, FTE weeks) and flagged in capacity registry.
- Rollout and rollback criteria documented.
- Monitoring and regression tests linked.
- Design review either completed or intentionally deferred with a plan.

Implementation notes and trade-offs:
- We recommend 2-week slices for high-latency work (e.g., infra changes with rollout risk) and 4–6 week slices for feature work that requires end-to-end validation. Shorter slices increase coordination overhead but reduce long tail.
- Automated dependency detection (via GitHub labels / linked PRs) is desirable but not feasible in pilot; start with a lightweight YAML registry maintained by PMs.
- Dashboard data will initially be derived from the registry + manual inputs; later iterations will ingest GitHub/Linear links for automation.

Next steps (owner):
- Draft ripple model doc (Asha) — in progress.
- Prototype execution-slice template and pilot with Runtime and Console teams (Liam) — pilot kickoff scheduled.
- Design review of dashboard wireframes (Mar 2) — design feedback incorporated.

Related artifacts:
- Draft Ripple Model (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OKR/Draft-Ripple-Model
- Execution-slice template (Google Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/exec-slice-template
- Example filled contract for runtime-1.18: https://drive.redwood.ai/runtime-1.18-contract
- Dashboard prototype (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/Redwood/okr-ripple-dashboard

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Teams treat contracts as paperwork. Mitigation: require a signoff gate in the roadmap import flow and a brief "capacity commit" step in the Console.
- Risk: Overhead for small initiatives. Mitigation: allow "micro-slice" shortcut with a 1-page contract for <3 person-weeks work.

Longer-term vision:
- Integrate initiative contracts into Console's rollout tooling so rollouts automatically surface ripple alerts and suggested fallback models (e.g., fallback to a smaller model variant or routing policy).
